blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO. Ilocos Sur — Ninety-five laptops were distributed to two public schools in Ilocos Norte on Tuesday as part of the rollout of the government’s Enhancing Teachers’ Unimpeded Rational Objectives (E-TURO) Digital Learning System. San Nicolas Elementary School received 47 laptops, while Dingras West Central Elementary School received 48 during the turnover and deployment
